scene: A sphere rolls down a long inclined ramp, hits three cubes stacked at the bottom and knocks them over. The camera slowly orbits 90 degrees around the scene from the left side.
Two interlocking gears on a wall rotate in opposite directions at matching speeds while the camera dollies in from a wide shot to a close-up.
A chess pawn made as a smooth turned (lathe) profile stands on a square pedestal. The camera makes one complete 360-degree orbit around it while slowly rising.
